name: Adjustable Center Point for Voronoi Partitioning
definition: A modification to the Voronoi partitioning where the center point of the barycentric triangle/simplex is adjusted to better handle specific material distributions, such as T-intersections.
summary: Adjustable Center Point for Voronoi Partitioning shifts the simplex centroid to arbitrary locations, improving material interface accuracy in non-uniform distributions unlike standard symmetric subdivision.
